list.name: log_group
list.label: 로그 그룹
list.description: 국가 정보가 포함된 Nginx 보강 로그 그룹

list.name: ip_re
list.label: IP (정규식)
list.description: Sentinel이 클릭한 IP를 넣어 줍니다. .* 는 전체

list.name: path_re
list.label: 경로 (정규식)
list.description: Sentinel이 클릭한 경로를 넣어 줍니다. .* 는 전체

targets.expression:
filter ip like /^(?:$ip_re)$/ and path like /^(?:$path_re)$/
| stats count(*) as total

filter ip like /^(?:$ip_re)$/ and path like /^(?:$path_re)$/
| filter status >= 400
| stats count(*) as errors

filter ip like /^(?:$ip_re)$/ and path like /^(?:$path_re)$/
| filter request_uri like /(?i)(union.*select|%27|<script|%3Cscript|\.\.\/|%2e%2e|onerror=)/
| stats count(*) as attacks

filter ip like /^(?:$ip_re)$/ and path like /^(?:$path_re)$/
| filter ispresent(country_name)
| stats latest(country_name) as country

filter ip like /^(?:$ip_re)$/ and path like /^(?:$path_re)$/
| stats count(*) as cnt by bin(5m), status

filter ip like /^(?:$ip_re)$/ and path like /^(?:$path_re)$/
| filter not (method = "GET" and request_uri like /transport=polling/)
| stats avg(request_time) as avg_time, max(request_time) as max_time by bin(5m)

filter ip like /^(?:$ip_re)$/ and path like /^(?:$path_re)$/
| fields (status >= 400) as is_err
| stats count(*) as cnt, sum(is_err) as errors by path
| sort cnt desc
| limit 20

filter ip like /^(?:$ip_re)$/ and path like /^(?:$path_re)$/
| stats count(*) as cnt, latest(country_code) as country, latest(user_agent) as ua by ip
| sort cnt desc
| limit 20

filter ip like /^(?:$ip_re)$/ and path like /^(?:$path_re)$/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200
| fields @timestamp, ip, country_code, method, request_uri, status, request_time, user_agent
